result.question: Why follow Abimelech?

readings.answer: Because his mother’s brothers spoke on his behalf and swayed the leaders.
readings.support: when his mother’s brothers spoke all these words about him in the presence of all the leaders of Shechem, their hearts were inclined to follow Abimelech

assessments.reason: The passage explicitly gives the reason: “for they said, ‘He is our brother,’” which matches “He was their relative.”

The text notes that when his mother’s brothers spoke, the leaders’ hearts were inclined to follow Abimelech, so their advocacy could be seen as prompting the decision, though the stated reason is kinship.
